answer: The design leans on time-locked work history, published publicly on failure, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. By the willow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A tundra of per-task receipts records who did what, and the quartz of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
